args.summary:
Modeled a 10-span (10×25 m) precast prestressed small-box girder bridge, continuous over the supports after erection, as a 2D spine-beam model (elastic beam-column elements, lumped at the girder axis, idealization spine_beam_2d, system continuous — no pier columns were described, so all support lines act as bearings on rigid supports).

Key modeling decisions:
- Girder: 4 small-box girders per span merged into one spine beam; single-girder mid-span section integrated from the given geometry (A=1.0605 m², I=0.25166 m⁴; yc=0.851 m), girder A=4.2421 m², I=1.00663 m⁴ (MR-02).
- Material: C50 → Ec=34500 MPa (JTG 3362-2018 3.1.5); γ=26 kN/m³ (JTG D60 4.2.1); self-weight only w=110.294 kN/m, mass m=11.243 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings: laminated elastomeric, effective plan 300×350 mm, 4×8 mm rubber layers (te=0.032 m), Ge=1.0 MPa default. Abutment 0 and Piers 1–4, 7–9, Abutment 10 → PTFE sliding (8 bearings/line: 2 per girder end × 4 girders), longitudinal free, Kh=0. Pier 5 & 6 → plain elastomeric fixed, longitudinal spring Kh=26250 kN/m. All: Kv=1.133×10⁷ kN/m, shape factor S=10.096, vertical spring, rotation free (MR-03, MR-04, JTG 3362-2018 8.7).
- Live load: Highway Class I, one-way, 3 design lanes → n_lanes=3, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=310 kN per span (L0=25 m) (JTG D60 4.3.1).
- Impact factor: f1=4.415 Hz from modal analysis → μ=0.2467 (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Results (self-weight): support reactions 1088 kN (abutments) to 3125 kN (Piers 1 & 9), end-span mid-span moment 4985 kN·m, interior spans ~2314–3020 kN·m, support moments ~−5343 to −7263 kN·m. Modal frequencies: 4.415 / 4.536 / 4.884 Hz. Lane-load maxima: +6410 kN·m (end span), −4601 kN·m (support). generate_model passed all L1/L2/L3 checks.
